title: PhD Candidate · 職能治療學系
title_eng: PhD Candidate · School of Occupational Therapy
description: 研究 AI 輔助認知障礙診斷，結合動作科學與機器學習方法。其他研究主題和經歷：VR神經復健、 正念減壓、 Matlab/Android 研究軟體開發、 AI輔助文獻回顧方法教學。
description_eng: Research on AI-assisted diagnosis of cognitive impairment, combining motion science and machine learning methods. Other research topics and experiences: VR neurorehabilitation, Mindfulness-based stress reduction, Matlab/Android research software development, AI-assisted literature review teaching.

title: 創辦人
description: 出於對捕夢網手工藝的熱愛創立 Tela Aurea Lab，理解捕夢網走線數學規則後，開發網頁捕夢網設計工具，未來計畫無償提供給北美原住民的文化教育機構使用，希望能協助保存文化遺產。歡迎體驗互動式網站入口 每日一網 (Daily Dose)
description_eng: Driven by a passion for dreamcatcher craftsmanship, Tela Aurea Lab was founded. After understanding the mathematical rules governing dreamcatcher weaving, a web-based dreamcatcher design tool was developed. The plan is to provide this tool free of charge to Native American cultural and educational institutions in North America, hoping to help preserve cultural heritage. Welcome to experience the interactive website: Daily Dose.

title: 講師
description: 已受邀於企業、學術機構、非營利組織進行 150+ 場演講與工作坊。利用職能治療專業背景分析簡報表達技能，並設計系統化訓課程。
description_eng: I have been invited to give over 150 lectures and workshops at businesses, academic institutions, and non-profit organizations. I utilize my occupational therapy background to analyze presentation skills and design systematic training courses.

description_eng: Developed three systematic pocket courses (slide design, presentation skills, and presentation logic) and shared them with junior and senior high school students in remote areas and rural regions of Taiwan. Also assisted in recording short videos to share practical presentation optimization techniques (IG@CAPE).

description: 擔任遠哲盃「三分鐘英語科學創新挑戰賽（3MT4S）」校園講師與培訓顧問，協助國高中師生以英語短講呈現科學研究、回應 SDGs。主講〈三分鐘說科學：聚光燈背後的故事〉交流講座，並分享〈3 分鐘英文學術簡報秘笈〉，融入 Falling Walls Lab 經驗，指導學生以清晰結構與臨場表達詮釋研究亮點。
description_eng: Campus instructor and training consultant for the Yuan T. Cup 3-Minute English Science Innovation Challenge (3MT4S), helping secondary-school students and teachers present scientific research in concise English talks addressing the UN SDGs. Delivered the talk “Three-Minute Science: Stories Behind the Spotlight” and a workshop on crafting 3-minute academic pitches, drawing on Falling Walls Lab international-finals experience to coach structure, storytelling, and on-stage delivery.

description: 擔任啟夢教育（教育型社會企業）課程開發與營隊講師，協助「系統化科系探索」營隊設計。開發醫藥衛生學群 LV5 體驗課程，由 2022起於夏、冬令營自然組擔任課程講師；另規劃職能治療學系探索課程，把專業領域轉化為高中生可親身操作的科系體驗。
description_eng: Served as a curriculum developer and camp instructor for Qimeng Education (an educational social enterprise), assisting in the design of the "Systematic Departmental Exploration" camp. Developed LV5 experiential courses for the Medical and Health Sciences group, serving as a course instructor for the summer and winter camp nature groups starting in 2022; also planned occupational therapy departmental exploration courses, transforming professional fields into departmental experiences that high school students can engage in hands-on.
